column1: # Season 3 "Creep Season" as announced on the Paizo Printables Discord, captured 2026-09-25,
# cross-checked the same day against Logan's Archives of Nethys export (lacunafex.sqlite).
# PRE-RELEASE AND NOT AUTHORITATIVE. The announcement states base sizes and size classes
# directly, earlier than we normally get them - the Google base sheet still read 72 models
# with no October rows when this was captured. Confirm against the sheet and the shipped
# No P-numbers exist yet, so none of this can be keyed for merge-reference; join on name
# once the release lands. pack_guess is INFERRED from the prior seasons' pattern
# (S2P1..S2PB, WP1/WP2/WP4) and is stated nowhere - confirm from the shipped directories.
# variants: the announcement's "(3 Miniatures)" annotation, equivalent to the sheet's
# "(3 Models)" and to variant_of() in ledger.py - each is a separate mini needing a base.
# aon_size is the size class in Monster Core / NPC Core per the AoN export. It is only a
# sanity check: what governs printing is the vendor's stated base, since the vendor may
# deliberately sculpt onto a larger base. Where the two disagree, flag is set and the row
# needs the sheet or the shipped base STL to settle it. Four rows disagree - see below.

column8: DISAGREES: AoN Living Landslide is Medium (L5, Monster Core), announced Large 50mm
DISAGREES: AoN Brine Shark is Medium (L3, Monster Core), announced Large 50mm
DISAGREES: announcement is internally inconsistent - Large should be 50mm by its own convention. AoN: Young Fortune Dragon Large, Adult Huge, Ancient Gargantuan. 75mm implies the Adult
DISAGREES: AoN Adult Resurrection Dragon is Large (L12, Monster Core 2); only the Ancient is Huge. Announced Huge 75mm
